The '''agrocite cannon''' was an upgraded version of the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] developed by the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Species/Legends|species]] years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was developed by equipping a turbolaser with [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]], which greatly enhanced its destructive potential. During the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], Khormai [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Unger Gout]] used it to its full potential, easily destroying a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in one blow. Gout's cannons were destroyed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], "[[Sharp]]," and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]] near the end of the battle.{{Weapon-stub}}
